notes.title: Major Bug fix on 12 Dec 2024
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where players are unable load the next day when going to sleep or exit the house in Normal mode

notes.title: Announcement for Release Date of Home_0
notes.notes:
Hello all,

After months of development time, we are pleased to announce that Home_0 release date will be set on the 7th November 2024.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106031/671d1850d436fcce680d1a0815df4e6be6374bf6.png

A newer version of Home_0 Demo is also live now. You can download the new update now which should reflects the final version of the game better.
